svg.aria-label: Four unsupervised maps of the same 900 digits, colored by labels added after fitting. T denotes ten-neighbor trustworthiness and overlap the mean ten-neighbor overlap. Coordinate scale and orientation belong to each embedding. Data: UCI, CC BY 4.0.
